Done. Here's a summary of what was changed:

**Change made:** [`slugify/slugify.py`](slugify/slugify.py:70) — the existing docstring of [`_modern_truncate()`](slugify/slugify.py:69) was extended with a `Parameters` section describing all five parameters:

| Parameter | Description added |
|---|---|
| `text` | Intermediate slug string using the internal `'-'` separator |
| `max_length` | Maximum characters in the returned string, measured after separator substitution; `0`/negative = no limit |
| `word_boundary` | When `True`, only cut on whole-token boundaries |
| `separator` | Output delimiter substituted for every internal `'-'`; its length is counted toward the budget |
| `save_order` | When `True` (with `word_boundary`), stops at the first token that exceeds the budget |
